units: metres; glTF +Y up, the body faces +Z, its left is +X
positions: packed (KHR_mesh_quantization) in one volume for every mesh: at rest a stored position p is at D · p, D = any joint's world matrix × its inverse bind matrix (three.js: bones[i].matrixWorld × boneInverses[i]); a delta in metres is stored / D's scale

fromMakeHuman.about: MakeHuman target deltas (decimetres, Y up, the body faces +Z, its left +X) times scale are glTF metres on the same axes; the macro shape (gender, age, …) is already in the GLB's positions

attributes._MHVERT: Body: its MakeHuman base mesh vertex index (hm08, 0..13379)
attributes._MHREF: every other mesh: the three base mesh vertices it follows (mhclo binding; the eyes, teeth, tongue and clothes follow helper vertices, 13380 and up)
attributes._MHW: their weights; the vertex is at sum(w_k * basemesh[ref_k]) + a fixed offset

basemesh.about: every base mesh vertex (19158, helpers included) at rest: float32 x, y, z in metres, glTF axes, little-endian; a face target moves these, and through _MHREF/_MHW the meshes bound to them

materials.Head_Skin: the head and face, own UV layout (headUV below), head_color 2048, head_normal 2048, head_roughness 1024 (R skin mask, G roughness)
materials.Body_Skin: the rest of the skin, MakeHuman atlas UV, body_color 1024
materials.Eye_Cornea: the clear outer shell over each eye (KHR_materials_transmission 1, ior 1.376)

headUV.about: Head_Skin UVs: each island's source UVs mapped by uv' = matrix · uv + offset, all with v up (Blender's); the GLB's TEXCOORD_0 is (u, 1 - v)

head.source: MakeHuman atlas UV (the body texture's layout)

mouth.source: MakeHuman atlas UV (the body texture's layout)

sockets.source: MakeHuman atlas UV (the body texture's layout)
